name: Enemy Cooldowns:
note:
Basically used to determine rather an enemy
has a skill on Cooldown or not. Set the state
auto-removal timing to the cooldown of the
skill. Then, add the state to the user after
skill usage. AI script can check for the 
mentioned state as a condition to use a
certain skill. E.g if Spinning Axe is off 
cooldown, use Rage for more damage.
